name: rotary-inverted-pendulum-docs
description: Documentation site for the rotary inverted pendulum, including the in-browser demo of the deployed policy.

scripts.test: npm run test:policy && npm run test:geometry && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:assets

engines.//: Node runs the .mts tests directly. Type stripping is on by default from 22.18, so no --experimental-strip-types flag is needed and none is passed — which also keeps these scripts working unchanged on Node 24.
